title: Approval card follow-ups: ork check/fix CLI, note for unreadable checks, fix note in later gate briefs, checks 10+, refused-action wording, duplicate note

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Later notes from the S118 relay (2026-10-26). Owner decisions 2026-10-26: (a) ork approve with [HUMAN CHECK] items is TUI-only for now; add an ork check CLI (and ork fix) so ork approve works from the shell. (b) When human checks cannot be read at approval, approve and write a slicer note that says they could not be read (today: approved with no note). Other notes: (3) the owner fix note is not carried into later gate briefs after a red check or a gate FAIL (internal/engine/states.go, the fix-note path); (4) checks 10 and above cannot be marked in the TUI (digits 1-9 only); (5) a refused owner action shows as 'error:' on the run row (internal/tui/runs.go); (6) a duplicate approval note when the approval update fails after the note was written; (7) UI: align '(new)' files with the diff-stat column, a blank line between card blocks above 24 rows, a wrapped check line at 80x24 can push out the owner recommendation line.
